title: Social Security and Other Legislation Amendment (Caring for Single Parents) Bill 2013

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would increase financial support for single parents receiving Newstart and establish enforceable rights for eligible employees with caring responsibilities to request flexible work.
A supplement of $80 a fortnight would go to eligible single principal carers, and their income test would match that for single Parenting Payment recipients.
Payments would require a parliamentary appropriation, while eligible carers could seek workplace orders when requests to change hours, work patterns or location were refused.
changes: The Newstart income free area for single parents would become $152.00 plus $24.60 for each child.
Employers would have 21 days to respond to flexibility requests and could refuse only on serious countervailing business grounds.
Fair Work Australia could order flexible arrangements, with civil remedies for breaching an order.
summary.affected: Single parents receiving Newstart, eligible employees with caring responsibilities, their employers and Fair Work Australia are affected.
